title: The image of an embedded C¹ submanifold under an antilipschitz C¹ bijection of ℝ^P with injective derivative is an embedded C¹ submanifold with tangent spaces DΦ(T_xN)
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded d-dimensional C¹ submanifold in the sense of Simon Ch. 2, 4.1 (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d N), and let Φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be a C¹ bijection such that DΦ(x) is injective for every x and Φ is Λ-antilipschitz for some Λ ≥ 0 (|a − b| ≤ Λ|Φ(a) − Φ(b)|). Then Φ(N) is an embedded d-dimensional C¹ submanifold, and for every x ∈ N the tangent space of Φ(N) at Φ(x) (contract tangentSpace: velocities γ′(0) of C¹ curves γ : (−1, 1) → Φ(N) with γ(0) = Φ(x)) is the image DΦ(x)(T_xN) of the tangent space of N at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d N → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → Bijective Φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → AntilipschitzWith Λ Φ → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d (Φ '' N) ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, tangentSpace (Φ '' N) (Φ x) = (fderiv ℝ Φ x) '' tangentSpace N x
